row:
Learn how to manage your pain and improve your overall health from a licensed massage therapist.

My channel is about teaching you how massage therapy can impact your life and empowering you to take action and feel more in control of your health. 

Here you'll find videos on massage techniques, how massage therapy affects different conditions, self-care tips, discussions on mental health, my personal health struggles, and the path I'm still on to becoming a healthier version of myself.
